title: Updated durable functions read quotas
description: Updated documentation for the read API request quotas for Lambda durable functions. For more information, see Lambda quotas.

title: Auto scaling quota guidance
description: Added information about how throughput quotas affect DynamoDB auto scaling, so you can set table and index capacity within your per-table and account-level quotas. For more information, see Managing throughput capacity automatically with DynamoDB auto scaling.

title: Secondary index quotas
description: Added information about secondary index quotas, including the maximum base table size for creating a global secondary index without additional allowlisting. For more information, see Quotas in Amazon DynamoDB.

title: DynamoDB bulk put items is now available
description: You can now use bulk put items to load data from Amazon S3 into an existing DynamoDB table without consuming read or write capacity on that table. Bulk put items offers two performance tiers, Standard and Accelerated, to match your workload requirements. For more information, see DynamoDB bulk put items: how it works.

title: Bulk put items CloudTrail events
description: Added information about CloudTrail logging for bulk put items operations, which records the StartBulkPutItems management event and BulkPutItems data service events. For more information, see Bulk put items considerations, quotas, and permissions.

title: Increased vector index quota
description: Updated documentation for the per-table vector index quota, which you can now increase to a maximum of 20 vector indexes per table. For more information, see Quotas in Amazon DynamoDB, Using DynamoDB as a stora

title: API Portal
description: API Portal discovers the APIs running behind API Gateway REST APIs, Application Load Balancer, and CloudFront across your AWS account or your organization in AWS Organizations, evaluates their security posture, and lets you publish documentation portals for them. For more information, see API Portal.

title: T9g burstable performance instances
description: Added documentation for T9g burstable performance instances, the latest-generation AWS Graviton5-based burstable instances. For more information, see Burstable performance instances, Key concepts for burstable performance instances,

title: Capacity Manager supportability checks
description: Updated documentation for Amazon EC2 Capacity Manager real-time supportability checks, fulfillment metrics, and capacity check quotas, including the --instance-requirements-with-metadata attribute input. For more information, see EC2 Capacity Manager.

title: Increased maximum PromQL query time range
description: CloudWatch increased the maximum time range for a PromQL query from 7 days to 30 days for all accounts. The limit description now explains how the time range is measured. For more information, see PromQL limits and restrictions.

title: CloudWatchFullAccessV2 policy update
description: CloudWatch updated the kms:DescribeKey permission in the CloudWatchFullAccessV2 managed policy so that you can also use it for requests that CloudWatch makes on your behalf, in addition to requests from CloudWatch Logs. The permission still applies only to keys in your own account. For more

title: OTel Container Insights changes in add-on version 7.0.0
description: Version 7.0.0 of the Amazon CloudWatch Observability Amazon EKS add-on and Helm chart removes duplicate series, deprecated attributes, and some generated labels from OTel Container Insights metrics. For more information, see Upgrading OTel Container Insights to version 7.0.0.

title: Amazon RDS reports snapshot storage charges at per-snapshot granularity
description: Amazon RDS now attributes snapshot storage charges to each snapshot individually in AWS Cost Explorer and your AWS Cost and Usage Report. The ResourceId field shows the Amazon RDS snapshot ARN, or the Amazon RDS cluster snapshot ARN for Multi-AZ DB cluster snapshots. Your pricing and overall charges are unchanged. title: Web Search on Amazon Bedrock expands language support and country-aware search
description:
Web Search on Amazon Bedrock, the tool that grounds AI agents and applications in cited, current web information, now supports five new languages, plus non-US English, on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Amazon Bedrock: Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Japanese.  Agents serving users in these languages get results that draw on local-language sources.

title: AWS Lambda now publishes Event Function state change events to Amazon EventBridge
description: AWS Lambda now publishes Event Function state change events to Amazon EventBridge. Lambda emits an event each time an Event Function version changes state because of a customer action, such as creating, updating, publishing, or deleting a function. title: Amazon Cognito extends multi-Region replication to additional AWS Regions
description: Amazon Cognito multi-Region replication (MRR) now supports additional AWS Regions, extending the resilience benefits of MRR to more workloads. title: AWS CloudFormation Service-Managed StackSets adds custom execution roles with nested stacks support
description: AWS CloudFormation StackSets now supports custom execution roles for service-managed stack sets, which enables you to scope the permissions StackSets uses in each target AWS account. title: AWS CloudFormation increases the default stacks per account quota to 300,000
description:
AWS CloudFormation now supports up to 300,000 stacks in each AWS account and Region by default (previously 2,000), which enables you to add stacks as your workloads grow without requesting a quota increase. CloudFormation manages related AWS resources as a stack that you create, update, and delete as one unit. Teams that deploy a separate stack for each customer, environment, or developer can now scale those patterns within a single account.
